turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
What went through your mind then?
They offered me cognitive behavioural therapy starting in March, eight weekly sessions.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
And how was that for you?
The perinatal team assessed me today and said I have postnatal anxiety with some obsessive thoughts.
Tell me more about that.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. Yes, it was like that.
What went through your mind then?
Tom has four night shifts this week so I am by myself with Oliver again.
Tell me more about that.
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. I keep coming back to it.
And how was that for you?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little.
What went through your mind then?
Oliver started sleeping five hours in a row, which is new.
How did that feel for you?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. I think so, yes.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
